patch_description: This version keeps the current program’s demand-based routing features and online LP-score model, while making the search portfolio more explicit: it combines bottleneck-focused and random 2-exchanges, 3-link rotations, short perturbation walks, and direct steps toward another archive network. Initial starts and LP batches are selected for a mix of predicted quality and structural diversity, rather than relying on one ranking signal. The implementation remains size-adaptive and uses only the supplied tools for LP scoring.
